notes.title: Kanji Legends Update 2.5 & Summer Sale Discount!
notes.content:
1.New Trials and Revamped Challenges Trial of Ice
A fresh trial that challenges your perception and memory.

Shatter the ice blocks to uncover the correct hidden character.

Features icy visuals and a distinct frozen environment.


Trial of Readings
A new quiz-style trial that tests your knowledge of Kanji.

Identify the correct On’yomi and Kun’yomi readings for each character.

Designed to challenge memory, recognition, and reading accuracy.


 Trial of Readings Plus
Follows the same format as the standard trial but with increased difficulty.

 Readings are presented directly in Kana, requiring sharper recognition skills.


Trial of Wisdom (Rework)
Redesigned to be more beginner-friendly.

Answer selection simplified: now choose the correct option by clicking instead of typing.


Trial of Mist (Rework)
Improved character placement for better visibility and clarity.


2.New Card SeriesSeries 5 & 6 Released!Over 300 brand-new cards to find and collect.

3.UI Improvements
Added detailed descriptions and info for each Trial and Ordeal.

Introduced animations to enhance select UI elements.

Improved Kanji list layout.

Removed outdated artwork.


4.Kanji Database
Updated Kanji list and grades.

Improved translations for greater accuracy.

Corrected typos and errors.


5.New locations
Added a new start menu background.

Introduced new scenery locations for the latest trials.


6.Bug fixes & Minor Improvements
Removed unnecessary light sources.

Removed old, unused meshes.

Reworked environments for Trial of Wisdom and Trial of Wisdom.

Improved camera placement.

Codebase improvements.

notes.title: Kanji Legends – Update 2.4
notes.content:
1. Ordeals – A New Challenging Mode
Put your knowledge to the test in four brand-new, high-difficulty game modes!

[olist]
Ordeal of Mystery

- Characters types are completely random.
- You only choose the number of rounds and difficulty.
NOTE: Kana and Kanji characters remain separate.

Ordeal of Chaos

- Full unpredictability: random characters, rounds, and difficulty.
- Chaotic visuals and SFX.

Ordeal of Madness

- ¿¿¿

Ordeal of Infinity

- Endless challenge with no fixed round count.
- Beat as many rounds as possible!
[/olist]

2. Trials – New & Improved

[olist]
NEW - Trial of Flames

- A fiery new challenge featuring bold visuals.

 Unified Trials System!

- Kanji and Kana trials are now merged! Use either character set freely!
- Merged Trials:
              Trial of Knowledge ➝ Merged with Trial of Wisdom
              Trial of Haste ➝ Merged with Trial of Agility
              Trial of Sight ➝ Merged with Trial of Perception

Trial of Mist

- Now supports Kana characters.
- Improved visuals.
- New SFX.

Trial of Choice

- Redesigned codebase and visuals.
[/olist]


3. Custom Characters Screen Rework!

- Kana: Select character rows and columns based on vowels or consonants.
- Kana characters are now properly sorted based on the standard model.
- Improved layout.

4. New Kana & Kanji Menus

- Access all Kana and Kanji characters directly from the main menu.
- Kana characters are now properly sorted based on the standard model.
- New feature: Mark characters as “Learned” for tracking progress ( Progress mechanic will be expanded in the next updates).
- Improved layout.

5. Series 4 Kanji Cards

A brand-new set of collectible cards!
- Exclusive drops from Ordeal modes.
NOTE: Ordeal of Infinity and does not grant card drops.(It will feature a different type of collectible in the future!)

6. Major UI Rework

- New menu animations and graphics.
- Removed outdated UI elements.
- Simplified navigation and layout.
- Stats UI updated to support the new Trials and Ordeals.
- Stats UI now includes a Total Clears counter.


7. New locations

- Added locations for the new game modes.
- Removed deprecated and unused areas.
- Improved lighting and overall visual fidelity.

8. Miscellaneous

- New effects and visual upgrades throughout the game.
- Completely removed menu navigation animations.
- Codebase improvements for better performance and scalability.

9. Bug Fixes

-Fixed an issue where the Insta-Win power-up HUD would persist after use.

notes.title: Kanji Legends Update 2.3
notes.content:
1. Clear Points (CP) & New Trial Rank System 

    New Points System: "CP - Clear Points" has been introduced.
  - Earn CP by completing trials — the higher the difficulty and set count, the more points you earn.
  - Simplified Stats Menu
  - All ranks for a single trial have been merged into one.
  - Gaining CP will increase your trials rank.

2. Variation Points (VP) 
   New Currency: "VP - Variation Points" has been introduced.
  - Rewarded for completing and Trial with at least two or more Characters tiers or types selected.
  - Trial of Choice requires at least three tiers or types selected.
  - Spend your earned VP in the shop.

3. New Kanji Cards Store
   - Spend VP to get card packs from the store.
   - Each pack contains 3 random cards from each series.
   - Available Packs: Bronze, Silver, Gold, Ruby, and Diamond.

4. Practice Mode New Feature
   - A new support feature is now available for a better learning experience. 
   - All trials can now be practiced using a new 'Hint' system.

5. Skip Travel Animations
   - Toggle this feature on/off from the main menu settings.

6. Series 3 Cards Now Available
   - Exclusive Drops: Only available from Medium or higher difficulty trials.
   - You can also find them in the Card Pack shop.

7. Power-Ups System Rework
   - Simplified and improved functionality.
   - Improved shop layout and adjusted prices.
   - Simplified the UI.
   - Changed the icons.

8. Kanji & Kana Boards Improvements
   - UI rework.
   - Optimized performance.

9. Other UI Improvements
   - Card Collection UI: Upgraded with animations.
   - Trials UI: Overhauled for better clarity and simplicity.
   - Added a range of new UI animations.
   
10. Technical Improvements
   - Codebase updates.
   - Overall performance optimizations.
   - Improved ambient lighting.
   - Various bug fixes.

notes.title: Kanji Legends: Update 2.2 - New Content & Winter Sale Discount!
notes.content:
Support Items:
- Support items can give you an edge in overcoming the most challenging trials.
- Earn "Legend Points" by completing any trial.
- The harder the challenge, the more points you earn.
- Use your earned points to shop in the in-game Store.

Kanji Cards - Series 2!
- Over 100 new Kanji Cards to find and collect!

Update 2.2 Highlights:
- New location: "Shop"
- Series 2 Kanji Cards
- Minor adjustments to some trials for an improved experience.
- Bug fixes and graphical enhancements.
- Streamlined UI elements for better clarity.

Thank you for playing Kanji Legends. 
Happy Holidays!

notes.title: Kanji Legends: Update 2.1 – New Content & Features
notes.content:
Collectible Cards:
- Earn and collect unique cards as you progress through trials.
- Series 1 launches with this update!
- Higher difficulty trials yield rarer and more valuable cards.
- Each card features a distinct rarity level, adding excitement and challenge to every trial.
- Certain cards contain hints for future content and hidden secrets! — stay tuned for more surprises!

- Enhanced UI Elements: Improved interface for a smoother experience.
- Gameplay Reworks: Adjustments to enhance overall balance and enjoyment.

Start your journey to collect them all and explore the new features!

notes.title: Patch Notes 2.0.1 - Hotfix 1 Updated
notes.content:
- Fixed an issue that caused the timer to activate during practice mode.
- Minor graphical adjustments.
- Fixed a bug where the game timer would not properly disable post-game.
- Fixed an image overlap bug in the Trial of Perception and Sight.
New assets prepared for upcoming updates. Stay tuned!

Thank you for your valuable feedback and dedication!

notes.title: Update/Patch Notes 2.0.1
notes.content:
- Trial of Haste/Agility reworked.
- Improved Timer Mechanic: Enhanced the functionality and accuracy of the in-game timer for a smoother experience.
- Practice Mode Fix: Resolved an issue where the practice mode remained active during the trials and rendering them unplayable.
- Graphical Enhancements: Updated visuals for a more comfortable and refined visual experience.
- Selection Bug Fix: Addressed a bug where custom-selected Kana or Kanji characters would persist and mix with default sets.
 - Navigation Improvements: Optimized the navigation system for Kana and Kanji boards.
 - Minor UI Enhancements: Introduced subtle improvements to the user interface for better accessibility and aesthetics.
 - Additional Bug Fixes: Various other bugs were identified and resolved to improve overall stability and performance.

notes.title: Update 2.0
notes.content:
Kanji Legends Update 2.0 is Now Live!
What's New:

   - Expanded Kanji List: We've added 1,130 new Kanji characters to help you master even more of the language.
   - Enhanced Player Stats: Keep better track of your progress with an improved stats menu.
   - Simplified Navigation: Enjoy a more intuitive and streamlined menu navigation system.
   - Upgraded UI & Art: Aesthetic improvements for a more visually appealing experience.
   - Feature Relocation: We've reorganized some features for smoother gameplay and a better overall user experience.
   - Practice Mode Enhancements: Practice mode has been fine-tuned for better learning efficiency.
   - Improved Kana and Kanji Charts: New and improved charts for quicker reference and learning.
   - Codebase Improvements: Behind-the-scenes optimizations for smoother performance.
   - Bug Fixes & Improvements: Minor bugs squashed and improvements made across the board.
